name: logo-groups
title: Logo groups
description: Customers grouped by industry or segment under small headings, so an enterprise buyer finds the sector that matters in one glance.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and groups ({ title, count, logos, href? }). Logos use the Logo type of LogoCloud (name, mark, href); every mark is drawn at one height in the muted text colour and comes to full strength on hover and focus, and each keeps its company name for screen readers. count is written as you want it ('38 customers'); give a group href and the count becomes a link to that sector's customer list, named 'in {sector}' for screen readers (labels.inGroup translates it). Groups sit in two columns from 640px and one on a phone, cut apart by hairlines; an odd last group spans both columns. From 1024px the marks of each group sit on a two-column grid (four in a row for a group that spans), so four marks make a tidy two by two and the groups line up with each other; below that they wrap. A mark with no image or SVG is set as text in a muted tone that still meets AA contrast. Renders on the server.
